```yaml
name: Build Linux No-Container Wheels

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      platform:
        required: true
        type: string
      python-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      build-type:
        required: true
        type: string
      wheel-dir:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "dist"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Setup Linux Environment
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux@main
        with:
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
          cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          compiler: gcc-11
          submodules: false
          checkout-mode: shallow

      - name: Setup uv
        run: |
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential

      - name: Checkout flash-attention
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: flash-attention

      - name: Setup Python environment
        run: |
          cd flash-attention
          uv venv --python ${{ inputs.python-version }} .venv
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
          uv pip install -r requirements.txt
          uv pip install -e .

      - name: Build wheels
        id: build_wheels
        run: |
          cd flash-attention
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python setup.py bdist_wheel

      - name: Locate wheel files
        id: locate_wheels
        run: |
          cd flash-attention
          WHEELS=$(find dist -name "*.whl" -type f | tr '\n' ' ')
          echo "wheels=${WHEELS% }" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload wheels
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-${{ inputs.platform }}-${{ inputs.build-type }}
          path: flash-attention/dist/*.whl

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -rf flash-attention
          rm -rf .venv
          rm -rf ~/.cache/pip
          rm -rf ~/.cache/uv
          if [ -d "/usr/local/cuda" ]; then
            sudo rm -rf /usr/local/cuda
          fi
```
